final_assessment: Archived reference-docs to orbit/changes/archive/2026-10-13-reference-docs/: the six reference pages teach orbit and left the pending-rewrite list, the command-coverage check holds docs/cli.md and docs/commands.md to the program and the workflow registry, and orbit feedback files on las-sal/orbit-spec; review-system passed on a blind pair walked in two logs and an in-context verification grading six entries landed.
warnings: orbit init and orbit update still print upstream's Learn more URL, and orbit init its Feedback URL (src/core/init.ts, src/core/update.ts): CLI strings under R-ugd-3, outside this stage's carve-out, which covers orbit feedback alone; no page teaches them.
docs/supported-tools.md, which commands.md links for how Codex invokes the workflows, still describes upstream until concept-docs rewrites it.

Pre-archive audit: two Category 5 touchpoint SUGGESTIONs, both explained: docs/customization.md (the system walk's one-line anchor repoint) and orbit/architecture/update-gh-documentation.md (R-ugd-10's wording restated at the proposal walk, Sal: A).

judgements.reasoning: Both system halves read the shipped pages against the code: the fresh half checked every flag against --help and the config, profile, gate and body claims against their sources, and the external half found the two claims that could mislead a lifecycle decision (review freshness after an edit; what bulk-archive omits). The walk repaired both and four suggestions, and the verification graded all six landed with a clean residual check. The coverage check, the feedback retarget and the pending-list exactness are mechanical and green on the full suite.

accepted.claim: PASSED means every finding is resolved, not that an independent pass stood clean on the final tree: the walk's six edits were read only by the in-context verification.
accepted.why: rc07's distinction; the edits are sentence-level rewordings each re-read at its source, and a further independent pass on prose would buy little against its cost.

accepted.claim: The coverage check proves a command is NAMED, never that it is TAUGHT correctly; prose accuracy rests on the two reviews, and four of the six system findings sat in prose written at apply.
accepted.why: Teaching is review's by the requirement's own last line; the concept-docs stage reviews the neighbouring pages under the same cadence, and public-readiness is validated by use.

accepted.claim: The external half could not run orbit validate or the scenario map: the runner's worktree has no node_modules or dist.
accepted.why: A known runner limit; the fresh half ran both, and strict validation and 11 of 11 declared scenarios were measured at apply.
